sources.snippet: A voice-native AI assistant for macOS and Windows. Say one word to control your computer and ask anything — Gemma offline, or Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini on your own key.

sources.snippet: This model is a state-of-the-art conversational AI system based on the Causal Language Modeling (CLM) architecture. It has been fine-tuned on large-scale conversational datasets to generate contextually relevant and coherent responses to user inputs.
